invariant: For a source containing native class declarations and shared package/container commands, a quoted container cannot force the later DESCRIPTION factory when the class command family can consume the source. Native class multiline bodies own their contents; bracketed member text is not a description command. A mixed-only description leaf before allowmixing or a standalone bracket description command rejects this earlier candidate. Later allowmixing cannot undo an earlier rejection.
